definitions.gloss: New Year, the beginning of the new year
definitions.explanation: A formal and slightly literary term for the New Year period. Used in greetings, advertisements, and announcements around the start of the year.

examples.japanese: {新春|しんしゅん}⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
{新春|しんしゅん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The New Year sale has started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{新春|しんしゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}される→放送する：01852_housousuru⟧。
examples.english: Every year, special programs are broadcast on TV during the New Year period.

notes:
USAGE:
{新春|しんしゅん} is more formal and literary than ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year). It is commonly used in greetings, advertisements, media, and ceremonial contexts rather than in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新春|しんしゅん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: New Year sale
- {新春|しんしゅん}⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: New Year special program
- {新春|しんしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{慶|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: formal New Year greeting
- {新春|しんしゅん}{初|はつ}{売|う}り: first sale of the new year

ETYMOLOGY:
The characters {新|しん} (new) + {春|しゅん} (spring) reflect the traditional East Asian calendar where the new year fell in early spring.
